nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 Liquidity Asset token the FundingLocker holds in escrow.
Immutable address of the Loan contract that controls this FundingLocker.
Constructor setting the immutable liquidityAsset and loan addresses.
Access-control modifier requiring msg.sender to equal the loan address.
isLoan-guarded external function transferring liquidityAsset amount to dst.
isLoan-guarded external function transferring the full liquidityAsset balance to the loan.
Caller address checked in the isLoan modifier against the loan state variable.
External SafeERC20 token transfer inside pull, transferring amt to dst.
External SafeERC20 token transfer inside drain, transferring the full balance to loan.
Destination address parameter of pull, forwarded to safeTransfer.
Amount parameter of pull, forwarded to safeTransfer.
Local variable holding liquidityAsset.balanceOf(address(this)) during drain.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the liquidity asset address into the immutable liquidityAsset state variable.
Constructor writes the loan address into the immutable loan state variable.
The isLoan modifier gates execution on msg.sender being equal to the trusted loan address.
The isLoan modifier guards the pull function, restricting who may trigger the transfer.
The isLoan modifier guards the drain function, restricting who may trigger the full-balance transfer.
pull invokes the SafeERC20 safeTransfer external call as its main body operation.
drain invokes the SafeERC20 safeTransfer external call as its main body operation.
The dst parameter is passed as the recipient of the token transfer in pull.
The amt parameter is passed as the amount of the token transfer in pull.
pull reads the liquidityAsset state variable to perform the token transfer.
drain reads the liquidityAsset state variable to query balance and transfer tokens.
drain stores liquidityAsset.balanceOf(address(this)) into the local variable amt.
The balance query for the local amt variable is performed on the liquidityAsset token.
The local amt variable is passed as the value of the token transfer in drain.
drain uses the loan state variable as the recipient of the drained token balance.

normalization_plan.reason: The dst parameter has no independent core semantics and exists only to supply the recipient of the safeTransfer call in pull.
The amt parameter has no independent core semantics and exists only to supply the value of the safeTransfer call in pull.
The local amt variable has no independent core semantics and exists only to supply the value of the safeTransfer call in drain.
